question: What is the proportion of 'Juvenile Population' (0-14 years) in India, as per 2011 Census?
solution:
The correct answer is __**30.76 % of total population**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• As per the **2011 Census of India**, the proportion of the **'Juvenile Population'** (individuals aged 0-14 years) was recorded at **30.76% of the total population**. 
• The juvenile population is an essential demographic segment as it represents the country's future workforce and potential contributors to economic and social development. 
• The **total population** of India as per the 2011 Census was approximately **1.21 billion**, and out of this, about **373 million people** belonged to the 0-14 years age group. 
• This percentage highlights the significance of investing in **healthcare, education, and child welfare** to ensure the holistic development of this segment.
